scope: Runtime source subset; no upstream examples, CI, Cargo.lock or additional test dependencies.
changes: Secret implements Zeroize, ZeroizeOnDrop and Drop; Debug is redacted.
Direct bc-shamir result buffers are Zeroizing until copied into another owner or consumed.
Upstream lib.rs retains the runtime API and doctest; its cfg(test) module is omitted.
Add deterministic ownership/error-path tests in secret.rs with a cfg(test) pre-free Drop observer.
Minimal manifest pins existing graph versions; no new crate version, feature or toolchain.
Error-variant documentation and an equivalent infallible GroupSpec default support existing workspace rules; the unchanged seven-argument metadata constructor needs no lint expectation.
Format runtime sources with the pinned workspace rustfmt; upstream compact formatting and import order are not retained.
Use the pinned local bc-shamir 0.13.0 recovery-secret owner.
Refuse a decoded group index outside its declared group count with GroupIndexInvalid; successful metadata/wire outputs and algorithms are preserved.
